out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the only handsink in the kitchen used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. VILLA BELLA ITALIAN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/29/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: all shelving in the WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connection under the sanitizing compartment of the 3 compartment sink is leaking. 3 comp sink faucet is not secured to fixture.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles throughout the kitchen are in need of cleaning. Area under dishwasher, area under 3 compartment sink, floor under equipment throughout and filters in hood system are also in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that a sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the handwashing sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: several knives hanging on a magnetic strip were not observed clean.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinara at the front pizza area (88°F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. REMOVED FOR REHEATING, LESS THAN 2 HRS HOLDING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salad refrigerated prep unit Cesar dressing (47°F), feta cheese (47°F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: in the walk in cooler baked ziti, minestrone soup, and lobster bisque.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. 3 trays of lasagna at 46°F-48°F in the walk in cooler cooked yesterday.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonium solution was measured above 400ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonium solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. SOLUTION WAS DILUTED.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling:3 trays of lasagna cooked yesterday stacked in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. DISCARDED.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: seasoned flour containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.
